title: Public Engagement as a Catalyst for Entrepreneurship Ecosystems
excerpt: A public celebration can become more than a moment of gathering. It can become a platform for entrepreneurship, collaboration, and local economic development. This article explores how Pentahelix collaboration can transform a community-based public event into an active entrepreneurship ecosystem, connecting universities, businesses, government, communities, and media to create greater visibility, networking, and opportunities for local MSMEs.
